deviations.what: onInit gives both MultiInputs a JavaScript setFilterFunction - a case-insensitive starts-with on the first, a contains on the second. A JS filter callback has no bindable or backend equivalent (the app-authored-JS-function boundary), so both suggestion lists carry UI5's default filtering and the difference between the two MultiInputs the sample demonstrates is lost.
